EN: We're close to tracking down the Wizard! Apparently his assistant abandoned him and is holed up at a Super-Duper Mart. We'll beat the truth out of him if we have to!
ZH: 我们快要找到水之术士了！显然，他的助手抛弃他，躲藏在一个大无敌超市里。万不得已的话，我们就打到他说出真相为止。

EN: The Reluctant Shill
ZH: 不情愿的托儿

EN: Track down the Wizard's assistant.
ZH: 找到水之术士的助手。

EN: Track down the Wizard's assistant.
ZH: 找到水之术士的助手。

EN: They called themselves the “Children of Atom.” Worship radiation, or something like that.
ZH: 他们称自己为“原子之子”，崇拜辐射或类似的东西。

EN: They kept saying we should rejoice, that “E-Ster” is coming. Don't know what that means.
ZH: 他们不停地说我们应该高兴“复活节”的到来。不知道那意味着什么。

EN: Thank you so much for helping us, we really appreciate it!
ZH: 非常感谢你帮助我们，我们真的很感激！

EN: Those religious fanatics said they had some “good news” for us.
ZH: 那些宗教狂热分子说他们有一些“好消息”给我们。

EN: They then started spraying people left and right.
ZH: 然后他们开始到处喷人。

EN: I managed to avoid it, but others weren't so lucky. Some have even been Ghoulified.
ZH: 我设法避免了，但其他人没有那么幸运。有的甚至尸鬼化了。

EN: Religious fanatics, you say?
ZH: 你说宗教狂热分子？

EN: Did they mention why they were doing this?
ZH: 他们提到他们为什么这样做了吗？

EN: No idea, but they kept saying it was coming. Some god or goddess, maybe?
ZH: 不知道，但他们不停地说它要来了。也许是上帝或女神？

EN: Yeah. They're usually pretty harmless. Don't know what's gotten into them.
ZH: 是啊。他们通常是无害的。不知道他们中了什么邪。

EN: Yeah, through that door... But it's probably too late for them.
ZH: 是的，穿过那扇门……但可能为时已晚。

EN: Look, someone is finally here to help us! Not a moment too soon...
ZH: 瞧，终于有人来帮我们了！来得正是时候……

EN: A few hours more and my friend here would have gone feral.
ZH: 再过几个小时的话，我的朋友就要变得残暴了。

EN: Curse those Children of Atom fanatics!
ZH: 诅咒那些原子之子的狂热分子！

EN: They can put that “E-Ster” of theirs where the sun don't shine!
ZH: 他们可以把他们的“复活节”挪到什么日光照不到的地方！

EN: What does “E-Ster” stand for?
ZH: “复活节”代表什么？

EN: Are you sure it was the Children of Atom?
ZH: 你确定是原子之子吗？

EN: Are there any more victims?
ZH: 还有更多的受害者吗？

EN: We've had reports of nearby Settlers being randomly sprayed with radioactive material by unknown assailants. We should deliver some RadAway to those settlers and find out more about the attacks.
ZH: 我们收到关于附近的定居者被身份不明的袭击者随机喷洒放射性材料的报告。我们应该给这些定居者送些消辐宁，并查明这些袭击的更多信息。

EN: The Rite of Spr(ay)ing
ZH: 喷洒仪式

EN: Talk to Settlers.
ZH: 与定居者交谈。

EN: Talk to more Settlers.
ZH: 和更多的定居者交谈。

EN: Investigate radioactive spraying incidents.
ZH: 调查放射性喷射事件。

EN: I don't get it. What's the point of randomly irradiating people?
ZH: 我不明白。随机辐射别人有什么意义？

EN: Good thing we brought extra RadAway...
ZH: 好消息，我们带来了额外的消辐宁……

EN: Well hey there! I'm Overseer Alvarez. Let me guess...
ZH: 哈喽，你们好呀！我是监督者阿尔瓦雷茨。让我猜猜……

EN: You're here looking for Vaultopolis, just like that Paula lady.
ZH: 你们来这里是为了找避难所大都会，和宝拉女士一样。

EN: I'll tell you the same thing I told her - you're in the wrong place!
ZH: 我还是会和你们说一样的话，就像我告诉她的，你们找错地方了！

EN: Vaultopolis does exist. Search the Vault-Tec offices to the north!
ZH: 避难所大都会是存在的，去北边避难所科技的办公室找找看吧！

EN: A friendly Ghoul in the nuclear power plant told us Paula Plumbkin continued her search for Vaultopolis in Vault 813. We're hot on her tail!
ZH: 核电站里一个友好的尸鬼告诉我们宝拉·普朗布金还在继续寻找大都会。她去了813号避难所，我们赶紧跟上吧。

EN: The Road to Vaultopolis
ZH: 避难所大都会之路

EN: Search Vault 813 for Paula Plumbkin.
ZH: 前往813号避难所寻找宝拉·普朗布金。

EN: Search Vault 813 for Paula Plumbkin.
ZH: 前往813号避难所寻找宝拉·普朗布金。

EN: I was hoping you'd say that!
ZH: 我巴不得你这么说！

EN: Safe... here? Oh. Thanks, I guess.
ZH: 这里……安全？哦，我想说……谢谢。

EN: I wasn't lost! I was just, uh, taking the scenic route!
ZH: 我没有迷路！我只是，呃，选了一条风景优美的线路。

EN: You should head for our Vault. You'll be safer there.
ZH: 你应该去避难所。那里更安全。

EN: The Ghouls upstairs are dead. You'll be safe here now.
ZH: 楼上的尸鬼死了。你现在安全了。

EN: A keen-eyed Wasteland explorer has spotted a lonely cabin in the distance. Looks like someone, or something, is lurking inside.
ZH: 一位眼尖的探险者发现了一处孤零零的小屋。看上去像是，有人，或者有东西藏在里面。

EN: A keen-eyed Wasteland explorer has spotted a lonely outpost in the distance. Looks like someone, or something, is lurking inside.
ZH: 一位眼尖的废土探险家在远处发现了一个孤立的前哨。看来里面潜伏着什么人或什么生物。

EN: The Scenic Route
ZH: 风景优美的小路

EN: Explore the Cabin.
ZH: 探索小屋。

EN: Explore the Outpost.
ZH: 探索前哨。

EN: Who, or what, is lurking in that cabin? Only one way to find out...
ZH: 谁，或什么，会躲在那间小屋里？只有一个方法可以知道了……

EN: Who, or what, is lurking in that outpost? Only one way to find out...
ZH: 哨站里潜伏着什么人或是什么生物？只有一个办法能找出答案……

EN: Look, I'll pay you. Just leave me alone!
ZH: 听着，我会给你们钱的，只要离我远点！

EN: I haven't got any more, thanks to you! Just take this and go!
ZH: 就是因为你们，我还什么都没有！拿了这个赶紧滚吧！

EN: What does that even mean? Get outta here! I'll pay you to leave!
ZH: 那是什么意思？滚出去！我花钱让你滚！

EN: Your business advice is as lousy as your attitude! Here, leave me alone!
ZH: 你们的商业建议和态度一样差劲！拿走吧，别烦我！

EN: Howdy folks, they call me the Radscorpion Earl!
ZH: 亲爱的乡亲们，他们叫我辐射蝎厄尔！

EN: At least they did, till you made a mess of my business!
ZH: 结果你们一来，就坏我的好事！

EN: You have any idea how much that venom sells for?
ZH: 你们知道那些毒液值多少钱吗？

EN: And now you've set me back years!
ZH: 现在你们让我一下回到解放前！

EN: Consider this a sting, Earl.
ZH: 厄尔，你就当做自己被蝎子蛰了。

EN: Peddle your poison somewhere else, scoundrel!
ZH: 滚去其他地方卖你这些毒药吧坏蛋！

EN: You've been caught in the Pincers of Justice!
ZH: 你被正义之钳抓住了！

EN: Try another line of work, like farming.
ZH: 试着换个工作吧，比如说种田。

EN: Folks are being stung all over, and the problem is coming from Earl's Radscorpion Emporium. Time to put him out of business.
ZH: 乡亲们经常被咬，这都是因为厄尔的辐射蝎生意。是时候叫停这些买卖了。

EN: The Scorpion... King?
ZH: 蝎子……王？

EN: Find Earl.
ZH: 寻找厄尔。

EN: Kill the Glowing Radscorpion.
ZH: 消灭发光辐射蝎。

EN: Raising Radscorpions is hazardous business.
ZH: 养辐射蝎可是个危险的事业。

EN: First we gotta raise bugs, now Dwellers to deal with? This job stinks!
ZH: 我们先要养虫子，现在还要对付这些居民们？这个工作太烂了！

EN: Earl ain't paying me enough to put up with this!
ZH: 厄尔可没有付给我这么多钱来承受这些！

EN: The Search for Jobinson's Jersey!
ZH: 寻找杰宾森的棒球衫！

EN: Yeah, I don't think so.
ZH: 是的，我不这么认为。

EN: Have you tried asking the Freemasons?
ZH: 你问过共济会吗？

EN: Shh, keep your voice down... here, you'll need this. Ordo Templi Borealis!
ZH: 嘘，小声点……给，你需要这个。北极光神殿教！

EN: Hi there... I don't think I've seen you here before.
ZH: 你好……我想我以前没在这边见过你。

EN: Do you need assistance? Are you lost?
ZH: 你需要帮助吗？你迷路了吗？

EN: We can help you find your way back to your Vault if you want.
ZH: 如果你愿意，我们可以帮你找到回避难所的路。

EN: Just passing through, 23 skidoo!
ZH: 只是路过，23号，史酷多！

EN: We're looking for Moley.
ZH: 我们在找莫里。

EN: We're here because of [REDACTED].
ZH: 我们在这里是因为[REDACTED]。

EN: Aw, how cute, your very first bribe attempt!
ZH: 哦，真可爱，你第一次尝试行贿！

EN: Ah, well you should have said so before. Can't be too careful, you know?
ZH: 啊，你以前就应该这么说。你知道，越小心越好。

EN: Well whaddya know, so do we. All hail Discordia!
ZH: 你知道吗，我们也知道。向狄斯科耳狄亚致敬！

EN: I'm sorry, I don't think you're supposed to be here.
ZH: 对不起，我觉得你不该在这里。

EN: This is a restricted area, only [REDACTED] are allowed in.
ZH: 这是一个禁区，只允许[REDACTED]进入。

EN: Unless you have the key, we're going to have to kill you.
ZH: 除非你有钥匙，否则我们就杀了你。

EN: We've got plenty of caps.
ZH: 我们有很多瓶盖。

EN: We've got this stuffed bear...
ZH: 我们这有个毛绒玩具熊……

EN: We've got guns.
ZH: 我们有枪。

EN: Okay, that's hilarious, but we still have to kill you.
ZH: 好吧，这很好笑，但我们还是得杀了你。

EN: That... is the most profound thing I've heard. Go, I need to re-evaluate everything.
ZH: 那这是我听到的最深刻的事情。去吧，我需要重新评估一切。

EN: Is this what you think? Well, we'll see about *that*!
ZH: 你是这么想的吗？好吧，我们等着瞧吧！

EN: I don't know how you made it this far, but your journey stops here.
ZH: 我不知道你是怎么走到这一步的，但你的旅程到此为止。

EN: Do you have any idea what you stepped into?
ZH: 你知道你踩进了什么吗？

EN: Of course not. You're like cattle on your way to slaughter.
ZH: 当然不是。你就像去被屠宰的牲口。

EN: Any last words?
ZH: 最后一句话吗？

EN: [REDACTED]
ZH: [REDACTED]

EN: [REDACTED]
ZH: [REDACTED]

EN: [REDACTED]
ZH: [REDACTED]

EN: It is?! No one ever tells me anything! That's it, I'm going back to [REDACTED]!
ZH: 是真的吗？！居然没人告诉过我！行了，我要回[REDACTED]去！

EN: Psst... Dwellers, over here!
ZH: 嘘……居民，在这里！

EN: It's me, Moley! Come closer, so I can share the secret of [REDACTED].
ZH: 是我，莫里！走近一点，这样我就能分享[REDACTED]的秘密。

EN: Are you ready? I can barely believe it myself... Here it is.
ZH: 你准备好了吗？我自己都不敢相信……就这儿了。

EN: Vault-Tec has been running experiments on Dwellers for *years*!
ZH: 避难所科技在居民身上做实验已经有*很多年了*！

EN: Pfft, we've known that for ages... It's common knowledge by now.
ZH: 呸，我们早就知道了……这是常识。

EN: Keep this to yourself, but we've been contacted by one of our deep agents, codename Moley, who says he's uncovered a massive conspiracy with vast ramifications. Go over to Vault 322 to hear Moley's big story!
ZH: 你要保密，我们的一个高级特工，代号莫里，联系过我们，他说他发现了一个巨大的阴谋，影响深远。到322号避难所去听莫里的大故事！

EN: The Secret of [REDACTED]
ZH: [REDACTED]的秘密

EN: Unravel the conspiracy.
ZH: 解开阴谋。

EN: Question the Vault Dwellers.
ZH: 询问避难所居民。

EN: Question the Overseer.
ZH: 询问监督者。

EN: Uncover a far-reaching conspiracy.
ZH: 揭露一个深远的阴谋。

EN: Fnord.
ZH: 弗洛德。

EN: It's not paranoia if they're *really* out to get you.
ZH: 如果他们真的想抓你，那倒还真不是妄想。

EN: I wouldn't mind some Vril right now. I mean... Cram. Yeah, that's it.
ZH: 我现在倒想来点“乌拉（Vril）”。我是说……饱饱牌肉罐头。对，就那个。

EN: Warrior botanists. You saved me from the Raiders that followed me here. I will be forever in your debt.
ZH: 植物学家斗士，谢谢你们把我从掠夺者手中救了出来。我永远都欠你们人情。

EN: My people call me the Shadow Wolf, but you can call me Steve. I assume you know about Mole Rat Man?
ZH: 我的朋友叫我“影狼”，不过你们可以叫我史蒂夫。我猜你们已经听说过“鼹鼠人”了？

EN: He lives in that factory, training his “pretties.” Crazy man treats them like his children. Don't think he's right in the head.
ZH: 他住在那个工厂里，训练它的“小可爱”们。那个疯子把它们当自己的孩子。不要期待他脑子会正常。

EN: Some nefarious person has been training Mole rats to steal Tatos from under people's noses. We need to meet with a tracker who might have found the source.
ZH: 一个坏蛋一直在训练鼹鼠在人们眼皮底下窃取红果。去见见那个追踪者，他可能已经找到了事情发生的根源。

EN: The Shadow Wolf
ZH: 影狼

EN: Track down the tracker.
ZH: 寻找追踪者。

EN: Meet the tracker who may have found the source of the Mole rat infestation that's targeting Tatos.
ZH: 去见见那个可能发现鼹鼠窃取红果事件线索的追踪者吧。

EN: He's our brother now, and he won't come with you.
ZH: 他现在是我们的兄弟了，他不会跟你一起去。

EN: That's it, we're all in!
ZH: 就是这样，我们都加入！

EN: To me, Raiders!
ZH: 到我这儿来，掠夺者们！

EN: Vault Dwellers! You have no business here!
ZH: 避难所居民们！这里没你们什么事！

EN: Turn around and leave before we unleash our fury on you!
ZH: 在我们释放愤怒之前，请转身离开！

EN: You've been warned!
ZH: 你已经被警告！

EN: Release Brother Will and no harm will come to you.
ZH: 放了威尔修士，我们就不伤害你。

EN: I'll see your fury and raise you by a wrath.
ZH: 我会看到你的愤怒，看愤怒如何吞噬你。

EN: Here's a warning for you: get out of my way or I'll kill you.
ZH: 警告你：滚开，否则我会杀了你。

EN: Well, you'd better talk to him then, as he doesn't want to go back.
ZH: 这个，你最好跟他谈谈，因为他不想回去。

EN: Just to be sure, you realize that's a figure of speech, right?
ZH: 你知道，这只是一个修辞，对吧？

EN: He asked us to save him from his Church brethren, who are trying to kill him.
ZH: 他要我们把他从教友手里救出来，那些人想杀他。

EN: You Dwellers are brave, but the Brother is under our protection.
ZH: 你们这些居民很勇敢，但修士在我们的保护之下。

EN: If you want to kill him, you'll have to go through us first.
ZH: 如果你们想杀了他，你必须先经过我们。

EN: Do your worst, Dwellers!
ZH: 作最坏的打算吧，居民！

EN: What? We don't want to kill him, but to return him to the Children of Atom.
ZH: 什么？我们不想杀死他，却要把他归还给原子之子。

EN: If go through you we must, then go through you we will.
ZH: 如果我们必须要打败你，那我们会的。

EN: What do you mean, “under your protection?”
ZH: 你说“在你的保护之下？”是什么意思？

EN: Why? Has he found it? If so, we're all doomed!
ZH: 为什么？他找到了吗？如果是这样，我们都完了！

EN: He's convinced the sun is dying, and that a new one must be ignited to “save the Daylight.”
ZH: 他确信太阳正在死去，而一个新的太阳必须被点燃，以“拯救天光”。

EN: Right after the ritual Deathclaw Egg Hunt, which is tomorrow.
ZH: 在传统的死爪彩蛋寻宝活动之后，就是明天。

EN: Dwellers, please listen to me! I am Brother Will.
ZH: 居民，请听我说！我是威尔修士。

EN: You have to stop Confessor Alvarado's plans before E-Ster arrives.
ZH: 你必须阻止忏悔者阿尔瓦拉多的计划，在复活节到来之前。

EN: That's when he plans to detonate a 20-megaton bomb, aka the “Sixth Sun.”
ZH: 那时他打算引爆一枚20兆吨的炸弹，又名“第六个太阳”。

EN: Fortunately, I hid the bomb's main circuit board before running away.
ZH: 幸运的是，我在逃跑前把炸弹的主电路板藏起来了。

EN: Circuit board, you say? Oops...
ZH: 你是说，电路板？我的天……

EN: Why does he want to detonate this bomb?
ZH: 他为什么要引爆这个炸弹？

EN: When is this E-Ster supposed to take place?
ZH: 这个复活节应该是什么时候？

EN: We think Brother Will, the Church initiate who has gone missing, may have been kidnapped by a band of Raiders camped nearby. We'll send a team to rescue him, then inform Confessor Alvarado if and when we've brought him back to safety.
ZH: 我们认为失踪的教会见习信徒威尔修士可能被驻扎在附近的一帮掠夺者绑架了。我们会派一支队伍去救他，等他平安回来之后，再视情况通知忏悔者阿尔瓦拉多。

EN: The Sixth Sun
ZH: 第六个太阳

EN: Rescue Brother Will from the Raiders.
ZH: 从掠夺者手中拯救威尔修士。

EN: Rescue the Church's missing Brother.
ZH: 拯救教会失踪的修士。

EN: You're right. I'll find another gift. Here, take this.
ZH: 你说得对。我会再准备一个礼物的。来，拿着。

EN: Really? Thanks! I've always wanted to live in a Vault.
ZH: 真的吗？谢谢！我一直都很想住在避难所里。

EN: I thought a new pet would make a nice gift for my best friend.
ZH: 我想送给我最好的朋友一只新宠物作为礼物。

EN: Unfortunately, some Raiders jumped me and took my Pet Carrier.
ZH: 不幸的是，一些掠夺者跳了出来，拿走了我的宠物盒子。

EN: I tried to get it back on my own, but this is more than I can handle.
ZH: 我想试着自己把它抢回来，但是这个比我想象的要难得多。

EN: If you can find it, it's yours. I just want to get out of here!
ZH: 如果你们能找到它，它归你们了。我只想离开这里！

EN: You're safe now. You should get home.
ZH: 你们现在安全了，可以回家了。

EN: You should come to our Vault.
ZH: 你应该来我们的避难所。

EN: Oh... fine! Take it! Now get out of here before I change my mind.
ZH: 哦……好的！拿去吧！趁我改变主意之前赶紧离开这里。

EN: You're on!
ZH: 上吧！

EN: If you want this beastie, you'd better be ready for a fight!
ZH: 如果你们想拿回这个小动物，最好准备打一架！

EN: I stole it fair and square, and I'm not giving it up!
ZH: 这可是我正正当当偷回来的，才不会随随便便就给你们！

EN: That's no ordinary loot - it's a gift for someone's best friend. Now hand it over!
ZH: 这不是你们平时抢的那种东西——这是给某人最好朋友的礼物。现在交过来吧！

EN: If it's a fight you want, it's a fight you'll get!
ZH: 如果你们想打的话，我们乐意奉陪！

EN: So much for the spirit of giving! Some heartless Raiders have robbed a Wasteland Settler and stolen a gift meant for his friend.
ZH: 不要再讲什么奉献精神了！一些无情的掠夺者洗劫了一个废土定居者，偷走了他送给朋友的礼物。

EN: The Spirit of Taking
ZH: 拿走主义

EN: Confront the Raiders.
ZH: 和掠夺者对峙。

EN: Rescue the Wasteland Settler.
ZH: 拯救废土定居者。

EN: Optional
ZH: 可选择的

EN: Confront a gang of Raiders that stole a gift from a Wasteland Settler.
ZH: 和那群偷走废土定居者礼物的掠夺者对峙。

EN: Oh, how nice! You brought us more loot!
ZH: 哦，太棒了！你们给我们带来了更多的战利品！

EN: Looking for that loot we stole? How about some hot lead instead!
ZH: 在找我们偷走的那些战利品吗？要不要来点热子弹啊？

EN: Well, well, look who wandered in!
ZH: 哈，哈，哈，看看谁来了。

EN: You'll have to ask them - we need to put in a new crop!
ZH: 你必须得问他们——我们需要种上新的作物！

EN: You're the crew of botanists that's been helping out settlers?! Thank goodness you're here!
ZH: 你们就是那些帮助定居者们的植物学家吗？！谢天谢地你们来了！

EN: We haven't had Mash Tatos or French Fries in nearly a month!
ZH: 我们已经一个月都没吃上红果泥和炸红果条了！

EN: There's a group at a research lab off yonder that thinks it isn't a disease. They have an alternate theory...
ZH: 那边一个研究所里有群人认为这不是病害。他们另有一套说法……

EN: We're not botanists, but we want to help - what's their theory??
ZH: 我们不是植物学家，但我们想帮忙——他们觉得是什么原因？

EN: We've found out from a group of farmers that the Tato blight isn't restricted to just one location - it's hitting multiple farms throughout the Wasteland!
ZH: 我们从农夫嘴里了解到不止一个地方遭遇了红果枯萎——废土上的很多农场都没能幸免！
